entries.root_cause: Host Inventory normalized evidence enforced field and collection cardinality limits in Python but did not enforce the aggregate canonical JSON byte limit required by PostgreSQL. Provider-controlled evidence could therefore pass the application boundary, be classified as a successful snapshot, and only fail inside the persistence completion transaction when the database's 65,536-byte evidence constraint was reached, coupling a boundary-size mismatch to operation liveness.
